question: **Fill in the blank with the most appropriate phrasal verb**: The department was asked to ____ the outdated protocol.
solution: The correct answer is: **Option 1 (phase out)**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The phrasal verb **"phase out"** means to gradually stop using or doing something, especially in a systematic or planned way. (क्रमिक रूप से समाप्त करना) • **Example:** The company decided to phase out the production of its older models to focus on new technology. • The word **"phase out"** is appropriate for situations where something outdated or no longer useful is being removed step by step. (पुराने या अनुपयोगी चीज़ को धीरे-धीरे समाप्त करना) Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1 (phase out)**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Hand off** (सौंपना): To give responsibility or control of something to someone else. • **Example:** The manager decided to hand off the project to a more experienced team. • **Come across** (सामना करना): To find or meet something or someone by chance. • **Example:** While cleaning the attic, I came across my grandmother’s old letters. • **Play down** (महत्त्व कम करना): To minimize the importance of something. • **Example:** She tried to play down the significance of her achievements, but everyone knew how hard she worked. 48:Ta92, The correct answer is: **Somniloquist**.
